description: Hyperliquid's liquidation map for a coin or stock perp from real positions, not a model: AINDEX reads the open positions of Hyperliquid's largest accounts (exact liquidation prices) in a loop. Dollars liquidated within 1, 2, 5 and 10% of the mark on each side (longs below, shorts above), the five largest clusters and positions, and how much of Hyperliquid's open interest the scan covers.
name: liquidation_map
title: Where traders get liquidated
